x-provenance.divergence_note: This file mirrors the inline schema from the upstream README. The schema served at agent-trace.dev is a separate artifact generated from the upstream zod source (schemas.ts): it declares the same draft (2020-12) but uses the older `definitions` keyword under a top-level `$ref` rather than `$defs`, and its `version` pattern is two-segment (^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$). Selvedge emits "0.1.0", which passes this schema and fails that one. Upstream is not self-consistent on this point: the archived zod source carries a three-segment regex. See docs/agent-trace-interop.md, section Resilience.
